cases.name: Kenneth Arnold Sighting
cases.summary: Private pilot reported nine crescent-shaped objects flying at high speed near Mount Rainier. His description coined the term 'flying saucer' and sparked the modern UFO era.

cases.name: Roswell Incident
cases.summary: Debris found by rancher led to initial 'flying disc' announcement, later attributed to Project Mogul balloon. Most famous UFO incident in history with persistent controversy.

cases.name: Mantell Incident
cases.summary: Captain Thomas Mantell died pursuing a UFO in his P-51 Mustang. First death associated with a UFO chase. Later attributed to Skyhook balloon.

cases.name: Gorman Dogfight
cases.summary: WWII pilot George Gorman engaged in 27-minute aerial pursuit with luminous orb that outmaneuvered his P-51. Key Project Sign case.

cases.name: Lubbock Lights
cases.summary: Three Texas Tech professors witnessed V-shaped lights repeatedly over several nights. Photographs taken by student. Blue Book classified as 'Unidentified'.

cases.name: Washington D.C. UFO Flap
cases.summary: Radar and visual sightings over Washington D.C. airspace. F-94 jets scrambled but could not intercept. Led to CIA Robertson Panel and increased government secrecy.

cases.name: Flatwoods Monster
cases.summary: Children and adults witnessed fireball land on hill, then encountered tall entity with glowing face. Witnesses experienced nausea and terror. Classic close encounter.

cases.name: Levelland UFO Case
cases.summary: Multiple motorists reported glowing egg-shaped object causing vehicle electrical failures. 15+ independent witnesses over 3 hours. Electromagnetic effects documented.

cases.name: Betty and Barney Hill Abduction
cases.summary: First widely publicized alien abduction case. Couple reported missing time and later recalled detailed encounter under hypnosis. Generated 'grey alien' archetype.

cases.name: Socorro Landing
cases.summary: Police officer Lonnie Zamora witnessed egg-shaped craft with two small beings near dynamite shack. Physical traces found. Project Blue Book labeled 'Unknown'.

cases.name: Valensole Encounter
cases.summary: Farmer Maurice Masse encountered landed craft with two small humanoid beings in lavender field. Ground traces documented. Physiological effects on witness.

cases.name: Kecksburg UFO Incident
cases.summary: Fireball observed across six states before object crashed. Military recovery operation witnessed. Acorn-shaped object with hieroglyphic markings reported.

cases.name: Westall UFO Encounter
cases.summary: Over 200 students and teachers at Westall High School witnessed disc descend near school then depart rapidly. Some witnesses silenced by authorities.

cases.name: Shag Harbour Incident
cases.summary: Object crashed into harbor with multiple witnesses. Coast Guard and military responded. Object allegedly moved underwater before disappearing.

cases.name: Travis Walton Abduction
cases.summary: Logger allegedly abducted in front of six coworkers while beam struck him. Missing 5 days. All witnesses passed polygraph examinations.

cases.name: Tehran UFO Incident
cases.summary: Iranian F-4 jets scrambled to intercept brilliant object. Weapons systems jammed during approach. DIA classified as 'outstanding CIRVIS' report.

cases.name: Operation Prato (Colares)
cases.summary: Brazilian Air Force investigated intense UFO activity terrorizing village. Residents reported being struck by light beams causing burns. Extensive military documentation.

cases.name: Petrozavodsk Phenomenon
cases.summary: Enormous luminous jellyfish-shaped object over city, visible from Finland to Vladivostok. Sparked Soviet UFO investigation program.

cases.name: Rendlesham Forest Incident
cases.summary: USAF personnel at RAF Woodbridge reported craft over three nights. Physical evidence included ground indentations and elevated radiation. Known as Britain's Roswell.

cases.name: Cash-Landrum Incident
cases.summary: Three witnesses encountered diamond-shaped object escorted by military helicopters. All developed severe radiation-like symptoms. Lawsuit against US government filed.

cases.name: Height 611 (Dalnegorsk)
cases.summary: Reddish sphere crashed into Hill 611. Soviet scientists recovered unusual metallic debris with anomalous isotopic properties. Physical evidence case.

cases.name: Japan Airlines Flight 1628
cases.summary: JAL cargo flight crew observed massive walnut-shaped craft with lights for 50 minutes over Alaska. FAA radar confirmation. Pilot career affected by speaking out.

cases.name: Gulf Breeze Sightings
cases.summary: Wave of sightings with extensive photography by Ed Walters. Controversial due to debunking attempts but supported by independent witnesses.

cases.name: Belgian UFO Wave
cases.summary: Wave of triangular craft sightings over Belgium from 1989-1990. Belgian Air Force scrambled F-16s achieving radar locks. Over 13,500 witnesses filed reports.

cases.name: Ariel School Encounter
cases.summary: 62 schoolchildren witnessed disc land near playground. Children reported telepathic communication with beings conveying environmental warnings. Dr. John Mack investigated.

cases.name: Phoenix Lights
cases.summary: Thousands witnessed enormous V-shaped formation traverse Arizona sky silently. Two distinct events: moving formation and stationary lights. Governor later confirmed sighting.

cases.name: USS Nimitz Tic Tac
cases.summary: Navy pilots from USS Nimitz encountered white oblong 'Tic Tac' object exhibiting extraordinary flight characteristics including transmedium travel. FLIR video released 2017.

cases.name: O'Hare Airport Sighting
cases.summary: United Airlines employees witnessed disc hovering above Gate C17 before shooting through clouds, leaving circular hole in overcast. FAA did not investigate.

cases.name: Stephenville Lights
cases.summary: Hundreds observed massive silent rectangular object with lights. MUFON obtained FAA radar data showing unknown object near restricted Bush Ranch airspace.

cases.name: USS Roosevelt Gimbal/GoFast
cases.summary: Multiple Navy encounters including rotating 'Gimbal' object and high-speed 'GoFast' skimming ocean. Officially released Pentagon videos sparked Congressional hearings.

cases.name: Aguadilla Airport UAP
cases.summary: DHS thermal camera captured sphere entering water and splitting into two objects. Transmedium behavior documented. One of clearest official UAP videos.

cases.name: Hessdalen Lights
cases.summary: Recurring unexplained lights in Norwegian valley since 1981. Scientific monitoring station established. One of few ongoing instrumented UFO research sites.

cases.name: Skinwalker Ranch Phenomena
cases.summary: Ranch with long history of paranormal and UFO activity. Studied by NIDS and later AAWSAP with $22M Pentagon funding. Ongoing scientific investigation.

cases.name: USS Russell Pyramid UAPs
cases.summary: Multiple Navy ships documented pyramid-shaped objects hovering overhead. Night vision footage leaked and later confirmed authentic by Pentagon.

cases.name: Langley AFB Drone Incursions
cases.summary: Persistent drone-like objects detected over Langley AFB over multiple nights. Origin unknown despite extensive investigation. Base operations disrupted.
